en.page_title: ERP, Inventory & E-Commerce Projects - Bowei Xu
en.page_description: Software projects by Bowei Xu: an AI-powered ERP assistant, an internal operations platform (ERP/WMS/MES), its warehouse subsystem, and an OpenCart 1.5 to 3.0 upgrade.
en.project_1_desc1: Led the company's e-commerce migration from OpenCart 1.5.6.4 to 3.0.3.8, covering 2,000+ SKUs and 70,000+ historical orders with zero data loss and no business interruption.
en.project_1_desc2: Wrote SQL migration scripts for data cleaning, field mapping, and relationship rebuilding across major version differences.
en.project_1_desc3: Refactored frontend code, improved mobile responsiveness, and resolved third-party module compatibility issues to improve stability.
en.project_2_title: Internal Operations Platform (ERP / WMS / MES) - Fuel Cell Store
en.project_2_desc1: Designed and developed the company's internal operations platform, covering order management, warehouse and inventory operations (WMS), shop-floor production execution (MES), shipment monitoring, and business reporting.
en.project_2_desc2: Built dashboards that combine order, inventory, and shipment data to support faster operational decisions.
en.project_2_desc3: Automated recurring report generation and scheduled analytics tasks to cut down manual reporting work.
en.project_2_desc4: Implemented scheduled backups and recovery workflows to reduce system recovery time to minutes.
en.project_3_title: Warehouse & Inventory Subsystem (WMS) - Fuel Cell Store
en.project_3_desc1: Designed and built the warehouse and shop-floor side of the internal operations platform, covering stock tracking, receiving, supplier management, and purchase order lifecycle workflows.
en.project_3_desc2: Created real-time analytics for inventory turnover, stock aging, and demand signals to support replenishment decisions.
en.project_3_desc3: Implemented reorder alerts based on historical sales data and safety-stock thresholds.
en.project_3_desc4: Built directly on the platform's shared SQL Server schema rather than behind a sync layer, so stock reads and writes are immediate and cannot drift out of step with orders.
en.project_4_title: AI ERP Assistant - Fuel Cell Store
en.project_4_desc1: Built an AI-powered ERP assistant that answers natural-language questions over inventory, orders, suppliers, and purchase orders using LLM tool calling backed by secure server-side APIs.
en.project_4_desc2: Implemented role-based access control, audit logging, read-only query validation, and predefined business tools to prevent unauthorized data access and unsafe database operations.
en.project_4_desc3: Developed inventory forecasting logic using sales velocity, supplier lead time, safety stock, and reorder-point calculations to flag stockout risk and recommend purchase quantities.

zh.page_title: ERP、库存与电商项目 - 徐博伟
zh.page_description: 徐博伟的软件项目：AI 驱动的 ERP 助手、企业内部运营平台（ERP/WMS/MES）及其仓储子系统，以及 OpenCart 1.5 到 3.0 的电商迁移。
zh.project_1_title: OpenCart 电商平台升级 - Fuel Cell Store
zh.project_1_desc1: 主导公司电商平台从 OpenCart 1.5.6.4 升级至 3.0.3.8，覆盖 2,000+ SKU 和 70,000+ 历史订单迁移，实现零数据丢失、业务不中断。
zh.project_1_desc2: 独立编写 SQL 迁移脚本，处理跨版本数据清洗、字段映射和关联关系重建。
zh.project_1_desc3: 重构前端代码，提升移动端适配，并解决多个第三方模块兼容性问题，增强系统稳定性。
zh.project_2_title: 企业内部运营平台（ERP / WMS / MES） - Fuel Cell Store
zh.project_2_desc1: 设计并开发企业内部运营平台，覆盖订单管理、仓储与库存作业（WMS）、车间生产执行（MES）、发货监控和业务报表。
zh.project_2_desc2: 构建统一数据看板，整合订单、库存和发货数据，支持更高效的运营决策。
zh.project_2_desc3: 实现自动化报表生成和定时分析任务，减少人工统计工作量。
zh.project_2_desc4: 通过定时备份和恢复流程设计，将系统异常恢复时间缩短至分钟级。
zh.project_3_title: 仓储与库存子系统（WMS） - Fuel Cell Store
zh.project_3_desc1: 设计并实现内部运营平台中仓储与车间的一侧，覆盖库存追踪、收货、供应商管理和采购订单全生命周期流程。
zh.project_3_desc2: 构建实时分析能力，整合库存周转、库龄和需求信号，为补货决策提供依据。
zh.project_3_desc3: 基于历史销售数据和安全库存阈值，实现智能补货提醒。
zh.project_3_desc4: 直接构建在平台共用的 SQL Server 数据表之上，而非通过同步层对接，因此库存读写即时生效，不会与订单数据产生偏差。
zh.project_4_title: AI ERP 智能助手 - Fuel Cell Store
zh.project_4_desc1: 构建 AI 驱动的 ERP 智能助手，基于 LLM 工具调用和安全的服务端 API，以自然语言回答关于库存、订单、供应商和采购订单的问题。
zh.project_4_desc2: 实现基于角色的访问控制、审计日志、只读查询校验和预定义业务工具，防止越权访问数据和不安全的数据库操作。
zh.project_4_desc3: 开发库存预测逻辑，结合销售速度、供货周期、安全库存和再订货点计算，识别缺货风险并推荐采购数量。
